description: Payment flow showing the web queue handing off to the business queue before completion.

components.content: Provide the payment details for this application. We'll take you to a waiting screen while the payments team confirms receipt.

children.label: Cardholder name
children.hint: Enter the name exactly as it appears on the card.

children.label: Payment reference
children.hint: Use the reference shown on your application or invoice.

children.label: Email address for the receipt
children.hint: We'll send confirmation to this address once the payment is confirmed.

children.label: Amount (£)
children.hint: Enter the amount you are paying today.

components.content: After you submit, your payment will wait for a quick back-office confirmation before this journey completes.
Do not close the page until you see the confirmation screen, unless you choose to leave and return later.

stages.description: Back-office confirmation step for reconciling the payment before the applicant is released.

components.content: Record the confirmation details from the payment provider so the applicant can be released from the waiting step.

children.label: Confirmation reference
children.hint: Enter the provider or ledger reference used to match this payment.

children.label: Amount received (£)
children.hint: Use the settled amount shown in the provider response.

children.label: Notes
children.hint: Add any brief context the service team may need later.

stages.description: Confirms that the payment has been matched and the receipt is on its way.

components.content: We've matched your payment and sent a receipt to the email address you provided.
Keep your payment reference handy if you contact us about this application.

queues.description: Web user entering payment details and waiting for confirmation.

gateways.waitingContent: We're waiting for the payments team to confirm receipt of your payment.
gateways.waitingDeferMessage: You can leave this page and return later. We'll update this payment as soon as the confirmation arrives.
